gang.description: Shows current gang stats or help page.

gang_help.description: Shows the specified page in gang menu.

gang_create.description: Creates a gang with the specified name.

gang_display_name.description: Sets the display name of the gang.

gang_display_remove.description: Removes the display name of the gang.

gang_economy_deposit.description: Deposits the amount value to the gang.

gang_economy_withdraw.description: Withdraws the amount value from the gang.

gang_members.description: Your gang's members grouped by rank.

gang_list.description: List every gang, most members first.

gang_info.description: A gang card by gang name or by a player's name.

gang_chat.description: Talk to your gang only. Without a message, switch gang chat on or off.

gang_join.description: Join a gang that is open for recruits.

gang_recruiting.description: Let anyone join your gang (open) or invited players only (invite).

gang_bounty.description: Put money on a gang; the gang that takes one of its turfs collects it.

gang_kick_player.description: Kicks the player from the gang.

gang_rank_promote.description: Promotes the player to the next rank.

gang_rank_demote.description: Demotes the player to the previous rank.

gang_transfer.description: Transfers gang ownership to another member.

gang_ally_remove.description: End an alliance with a gang (by name).

gang_upgrade.description: See what the next gang level costs: the XP and the money still missing.

gang_upgrade_confirm.description: Claim the next gang level when the XP bar is full; the fee is paid from the gang bank.

gang_safehouse.description: Teleport to one of your gang's safehouses, after a short warm-up. Without a name, list them.

gang_safehouse_set.description: Set a safehouse where you stand (the number grows with the gang level).

gang_rally.description: Ask your online gang to join you, or to meet at a safehouse.

gang_rally_join.description: Answer your gang's rally call (a normal gang teleport with a warm-up).

gang_pvp.description: Let members of your gang hurt each other, or stop it.

gang_ally_pvp.description: Let your gang and an ally hurt each other; it works only when both gangs turned it on.

gang_notice.description: Set the notice members see when they log in, or clear it.

gang_chat_allies.description: Talk to your gang and its allies. Without a message, switch ally chat on or off.

gang_ranking.description: The gang ranking by kills, kdr, assists, level, members, online, turfs or fight wins.

gang_profile.description: A player's gang card: gang, rank, kills, deaths, assists.

option_gang_rank.description: Staff: set the rank of a member of your gang.

option_gang_disband.description: Staff: disband a gang (members are paid out as in a normal disband).

option_gang_leader.description: Staff: make a member the gang's leader.

option_gang_bank.description: Staff: gang bank balance, give, take or reset; logged.

option_gang_safehouse.description: Staff: gang safehouse list, tp or remove.

option_gang_stats.description: Staff: reset a player's gang kills, deaths and assists.

option_gang_spy.description: Staff: read gang and ally chat.

option_gang_purge.description: Staff: list or disband gangs inactive for Purge.Inactive_Days.

rank_help.description: Shows the specified page in ranks menu.

rank_create.description: Creates a new rank with the specified name.

rank_add_permission.description: Adds the permission to the specified rank.

rank_remove_permission.description: Removes the permission from the specified rank.

rank_info.description: Gives all the information about the specified rank.

rank_parent_add.description: Adds the rank to the specified parent.

rank_parent_remove.description: Removes the rank from the specified parent.

rank_vaultgroup_set.description: Links the rank to an external Vault permission group so members gain that group on assignment.

rank_vaultgroup_clear.description: Removes the Vault group link from the rank.
